symptom: `mxcli check tests/X.test.mdl` (and the VS Code LSP) warns MDL-V1-SLASH once per test, on the doc-comment line, although the skill says a test file takes no `mdl 1;` header
cause: `CheckSource` renders each block as a microflow and closed the wrapper with `END; /`; the rendering is parsed headerless, so the visitor recorded a V1 slash note on a `/` mxcli itself wrote. The author's `/` separators are blanked and never reach the parser
insight: Generated MDL must be canonical under every language version, or the diagnostics blame the author's file. `TestCheckSourceWrapperIsCanonical` asserted no Deprecations but not LanguageNotes; it now asserts both
